mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_status, selection_mode, separate_student_categories FROM selection_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE selection_batch SET batch_status = #{status}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN COALESCE(published_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE published_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FINISHED' THEN COALESCE(finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE finished_at END WHERE id = #{batchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO active_batch_student_lock (student_id, batch_id) SELECT student_id, batch_id FROM batch_student_eligibility WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND eligibility_status = 'ELIGIBLE'
